actions.desc: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.desc: The dragon exhales a cone of black, poisonous gas in a 90-foot cone. Each target in that area must make a DC 25 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes 91 (26d6) poison damage and is poisoned until cured by the greater restoration spell or similar magic. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't poisoned.

traits.desc: The cave dragon emits magical darkness in a 30-foot radius around it. The darkness moves with the dragon and spreads around corners. Darkvision can’t penetrate this darkness, and no natural light can illuminate it. If any of the darkness overlaps with an area of light created by a spell of 4th level or lower, the spell creating the light is dispelled. At the start of each of its turns, the dragon chooses whether this aura is active. A successful dispel magic (DC 15) cast on the dragon suppresses this aura for 1 minute.
traits.desc_ru: Особенность «Даркнесс Аура». Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
traits.name: Darkness Aura

traits.desc: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
traits.desc_ru: Если проваливает спасбросок, может вместо этого выбрать успех.
traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)

traits.desc: The cave dragon can burrow through any unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the dragon can choose whether to leave the material it moves through undisturbed or leave a 15-foot diameter tunnel in its wake.
traits.desc_ru: Особенность «Магикал Туннелер». Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
traits.name: Magical Tunneler

traits.desc: The dragon uses its spikes to hold itself in place while climbing, allowing it to climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check. If it climbs upside down on a ceiling or suspends itself on a vertical surface while leaving its claws free, it can’t use the Ruff Spikes reaction.
